```{r setup, include=FALSE}


raster_files <- fs::dir_ls("erie_raster_ex/images/", regexp = "\\.tif$")
print(length(raster_files))


single_raster <- terra::rast(raster_files[1])
terra::crs(single_raster)
terra::ext(single_raster)
terra::res(single_raster)
terra::nlyr(single_raster)
terra::global(single_raster, c("min", "max"), na.rm = TRUE)


clean_cicyano <- function(r) {
  reclass_matrix <- matrix(c(0, 0, NA, 
                             250, Inf, NA), 
                           ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  raster_cleaned <- terra::classify(r, reclass_matrix, right = NA)
  return(raster_cleaned)
}


test_clean <- clean_cicyano(single_raster)
terra::global(single_raster, c("min", "max"), na.rm = TRUE)
terra::global(test_clean, c("min", "max"), na.rm = TRUE)


dn_to_ci <- function(r) {
  ci_raster <- 10^((3.0 / 250.0) * r - 4.2)
  return(ci_raster)
}


test_ci <- dn_to_ci(test_clean)
terra::global(test_ci, c("min", "max"), na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}

sandusky_bounds <- sf::read_sf("erie_raster_ex/bounds/bb_erie_sandusky.shp")


if (sf::st_crs(sandusky_bounds) != terra::crs(single_raster)) {
  sandusky_bounds <- sf::st_transform(sandusky_bounds, terra::crs(single_raster))
}



august_file <- stringr::str_subset(raster_files, "0816_0822")
august_ci <- terra::rast(august_file) %>%
  clean_cicyano() %>%
  dn_to_ci()


august_crop <- terra::crop(august_ci, sandusky_bounds)
sandusky_0816 <- terra::mask(august_crop, sandusky_bounds)


mean_full <- terra::global(august_ci, "mean", na.rm = TRUE)
mean_sandusky <- terra::global(sandusky_0816, "mean", na.rm = TRUE)

print(mean_full)
print(mean_sandusky)


tmap_mode("plot")
tm_shape(sandusky_0816) +
  tm_raster(palette = "YlGn", title = "CI Value") +
  tm_shape(sandusky_bounds) +
  tm_borders(col = "black") +
  tm_layout(main.title = "Cyanobacteria Intensity: Sandusky Bay (Aug 16-22)",
            legend.outside = TRUE) +
  tm_scale_bar(position = c("left", "bottom"))
```


```{r}
stacked_rasters <- raster_files[1:4] %>%
  purrr::map(terra::rast) %>%
  purrr::map(clean_cicyano) %>%
  purrr::map(dn_to_ci) %>%
  terra::rast() 


means <- terra::global(stacked_rasters, "mean", na.rm = TRUE)


dates <- stringr::str_extract(names(stacked_rasters), "\\d{4}_\\d{4}")

temporal_df <- data.frame(
  date = dates,
  mean_ci = means$mean
)
print(temporal_df)


ggplot(temporal_df, aes(x = date, y = mean_ci, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "darkblue", size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Mean Cyanobacteria Intensity Over Time",
       x = "Date Range",
       y = "Mean CI")


r_early <- stacked_rasters[[1]]
r_late <- stacked_rasters[[4]]


bloom_early <- terra::ifel(!is.na(r_early), 1, 0)
bloom_late <- terra::ifel(!is.na(r_late), 1, 0)


persistent_bloom <- (bloom_early == 1) & (bloom_late == 1)
new_bloom <- (bloom_early == 0) & (bloom_late == 1)


plot(persistent_bloom, main = "Persistent Blooms", col = c("white", "darkred"))
plot(new_bloom, main = "New Blooms", col = c("white", "orange"))
```


```{r}

shp_files <- fs::dir_ls("erie_raster_ex/bounds/", regexp = "\\.shp$")

all_aois <- purrr::map_dfr(shp_files, ~{
  sf::read_sf(.x) %>% 
    mutate(AOI = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(.x))) 
})


all_aois <- sf::st_transform(all_aois, terra::crs(stacked_rasters))


highest_date_idx <- which.max(temporal_df$mean_ci)
peak_raster <- stacked_rasters[[highest_date_idx]]


all_aois <- sf::st_transform(shapefiles, crs = 32617) %>% st_make_valid()
glimpse(all_aois)

aoi_vec<- terra::vect(all_aois)

all_aois <- sf::st_transform(all_aois, crs = 32617) 
all_aois<-sf::st_make_valid(all_aois)
aoi_vec  <- terra::vect(all_aois)

extracted_vals <- terra::extract(peak_raster,
          terra::vect(all_aois), fun = function(x) c(mean = mean(x, na.rm=TRUE), max = max(x, na.rm=TRUE)))


summary_table <- bind_cols(all_aois, extracted_vals)

summary_table
glimpse(summary_table)

clean_summary <- summary_table %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(Shape_Area)

print(clean_summary)


tm_shape(peak_raster) + 
  tm_raster(palette = "YlOrRd", title = "Peak CI") + 
  tm_shape(all_aois) + 
  tm_borders(col = "black", lwd = 1.5) + 
  tm_text("AOI", size = 0.2, shadow = TRUE) +
  tm_layout(main.title = "Peak Bloom Intensity with AOI Boundaries", 
            legend.outside = TRUE)
```
